answer.answer: What changed: Atlas Runner's supported concurrency was raised from 8 to 16 concurrent jobs in version 1.1, as stated in its release notes [atlas-release-2]. What is current: As of version 1.1 — the latest version covered by the supplied snapshots — Atlas Runner supports up to 16 concurrent jobs [atlas-release-2]. What remains historically valid: The 1.0 release notes documented support for up to 8 concurrent jobs [atlas-release-1]; this was accurate for version 1.0 and was superseded by the 1.1 increase, and the 1.1 release notes independently corroborate that the prior limit was 8 [atlas-release-2]. Unresolved: No supplied source addresses any version after 1.1, so whether the 16-concurrent-job limit has changed since is unknown; the sources also do not indicate whether the limit is a hard cap or configurable, nor how concurrency behaves in other editions, tiers, or deployment modes.
